evidence.note: Yao in Canon of Yao names the already represented historical/traditional figure p020. Link this later textual reference without assigning He Chengtian's quotation date to Yao's life.

context.zh: 虞喜云：「堯時冬至日短星昴，今二千七百餘年，乃東壁中，則知每歲漸差之所至。」
context.en: Yu Xi said: "At Yao's time, winter solstice fell when the day was short and Mao was culminating; after more than 2,700 years it is at the center of Eastern Wall—thus we know the extent of the annual drift."
context.literal: Yu Xi said: "At Yao's time, at winter solstice the day was short and the star was Mao; now after more than twenty-seven hundred years it is at the center of Eastern Wall—thus one knows where the annual gradual difference reaches."

context.zh: 又何承天云：「《堯典》：'日永星火，以正仲夏；
context.en: He Chengtian also said: "The Canon of Yao reads: 'The day is longest and the Fire star is bright, to mark midsummer;
context.literal: He Chengtian also said: "The Canon of Yao: 'The day is longest and the Fire star is bright, to rectify midsummer;

context.en: the night is centered and Xu is culminating, to mark mid-autumn.'
context.literal: the night is centered and the star is Xu, to rectify mid-autumn.'
